                            <div id="accordionsection1002-collapse0" class="align-none media-none content pd-collapsible__content">
								

                                <div class="editor-content">
                                    <p>In many cases, you do not need to remove old mulch as it will naturally decompose into the soil. You may want to remove old mulch if the layer is too thick (more than 4 inches). If you choose not to remove old mulch, remember to loosen up your old mulch to improve drainage and airflow before applying a new layer.</p>

                                <div class="editor-content">
                                    <p>Generally, you should add fresh mulch to your landscape or garden once a year.</p>

### DESCRIPTION
Enhance your outdoor space with black wood mulch. This 1.5 cu. ft. bag of shredded mulch helps retain moisture. Scotts® Nature Scapes® Color Enhanced Mulch is ideal for around trees, shrubs, flowers or vegetables. For longest color, keep mulch dry for 24 hours after application. This color enhanced mulch never uses recycled waste wood, only natural forest products. Build a better landscape that you know will look great and be free of any construction debris and pallet wood. Landscape mulch offers a rich, natural black color that is guaranteed for a year with ColorGuard®.
### STEP BY STEP INSTRUCTIONS
**How to Use**
  * Spread 3 inches deep. Keep mulch several inches from tree trunks and house foundations or other wood structures.


### WHEN AND WHERE TO USE
**Where to Use**
  * Apply around trees, shrubs, flowers or vegetables after seeds have germinated and plants have developed.


**Where Not to Use**
  * Avoid use : Before seeds have germinated, around underdeveloped plants, and within several inches of house foundations or other wood surfaces.


## Frequently Asked Questions
### Do you have to remove old mulch before applying new mulch?
In many cases, you do not need to remove old mulch as it will naturally decompose into the soil. You may want to remove old mulch if the layer is too thick (more than 4 inches). If you choose not to remove old mulch, remember to loosen up your old mulch to improve drainage and airflow before applying a new layer.
### How often should you mulch your yard?
Generally, you should add fresh mulch to your landscape or garden once a year.
### Will mold in my mulch bag harm plants?
No, moldy mulch does not harm plants. Mold spores are naturally present in mulches and thrive under moist conditions inside bags. Mold and fungus are natural components in healthy mulch, and can contribute to a thriving garden.
